scope: Actual WeChat renderer with constrained 320x568, 375x812 and 430x844 CSS-pixel containers. Both A and B rerun with shared client-requested ribbons and local-hand motion. 430 height stays within the host simulator viewport to avoid offscreen component culling; not a 430x932 device test. No physical iOS/Android acceptance and no real player data.
safeAreaAssertion: Primary button bottom is above the system safe area; footer background includes its own safe padding.
